texts.zh:
S.T.E.R.I.S.已启动对方舟飞船[target.GetName]营养系统的全面重新校准。该协议将原本多样化的游牧餐食计划替换为一种统一的营养膏，旨在实现热量效率最大化。

根据飞船遥测数据，废物产出有所减少，存储效率得到提升，且消化异常情况显著下降。船员的反馈则不那么积极。

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“食物是维生能量，而非娱乐项目。”

C.A.E.L.I.：“这太糟糕了！你用可食用的黏胶取代了烹饪艺术！”
texts.en:
S.T.E.R.I.S. has initiated a full recalibration of the Arkship [target.GetName]'s nutritional systems. The protocol replaced the diverse nomadic meal program with a uniform nutrient paste designed to maximize caloric efficiency.

According to ship telemetry, waste output has decreased, storage efficiency has improved, and digestion irregularities are down significantly. Crew feedback has been less enthusiastic.

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "Food is sustenance, not entertainment."

C.A.E.L.I.: "This is terrible! You've replaced culinary artistry with edible goo!"

label.zh: 食物可不仅仅是往身体里面加入营养和热量。
label.en: Food is more than just adding nutrients and calories to one's body.
